definition: Techniques and methods aimed at making AI model decisions understandable and interpretable to humans.
details: XAI is particularly important in high-stakes domains like healthcare, finance, and criminal justice, where stakeholders need to understand why a model made a particular decision.
story: Imagine a new medicine that works brilliantly in the lab but still has to be tested on real people before anyone takes it. Here is the short version: Techniques and methods aimed at making AI model decisions understandable and interpretable to humans. The part that makes it sing: XAI is particularly important in high-stakes domains like healthcare, finance, and criminal justice, where stakeholders need to understand why a model made a particular decision. Rules and red-teaming are the brakes that make the speed trustworthy. And that is Explainable AI — the reason we can move fast without breaking things, or people.
